void_scar.name: Price of Contact — permanent Void Scar
void_scar.prompt: Describe your permanent Void Scar. Ordinary healing or retraining cannot remove it. Qi Sensing and Secret perception can identify it. Its stated narrative consequence grants no extra concealment or immunity.

five_elements_start.name: Fivefold Attunement — Starting Element
five_elements_start.prompt: Choose your Starting Element. You learn it and the next element in the cycle: Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water, then Wood. Cycle of Rebirth teaches the third element at CL6. This choice grants no Spheres or techniques.
